[taxnestc@eu1 ~]$ cd ~/public_html

echo "=== Live POST test with FULL response ==="
rm -f /tmp/c.txt
curl -sc /tmp/c.txt -o /tmp/login.html https://taxnest.com.pk/login
TOKEN=$(grep -oP 'name="_token" value="\K[^"]+' /tmp/login.html)
echo "Token: $TOKEN"
echo ""

# Capture FULL POST response (with debug=true, error page will be in response body)
curl -sb /tmp/c.txt -c /tmp/c.txt -o /tmp/post_response.html \
  -D /tmp/post_headers.txt \
  -X POST https://taxnest.com.pk/login \
  -H "Referer: https://taxnest.com.pk/login" \
  -H "Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml" \
  --data-urlencode "_token=$TOKEN" \
  --data-urlencode "email=admin@example.com" \
  --data-urlencode "password=anything"

echo "--- POST Response Headers ---"
cat /tmp/post_headers.txt
echo ""
echo "--- POST Response Body (first 100 lines) ---"
grep -iv "DB_DRIVER" storage/logs/laravel.log | tail -30="ass=\"[^\"]*error[^\"]
